answer: We formulate a mechanism combining dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices to deter Sybil attacks. Agents invest bonds in a garden of strategies, facing zenith payoffs for honest participation. Sable punishment matrices enforce strict penalties for deviations, rendering identity multiplication unprofitable. Capital barrier analysis reveals expected payoffs for Sybilization are strictly negative, guaranteeing Nash equilibrium convergence in adversarial environments.
